reason: Adds a DeepSeek Harness Web UI button that detects Windows IDEs and opens the current workspace directory in a selected or default local application.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加 IDE 按钮，用于检测 Windows 本机 IDE 并在选定或默认应用中打开当前工作区目录。
summaries.en: Adds an IDE button to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI for detecting Windows IDEs and opening the current workspace directory in a selected or default local application.

capabilities: Reads Windows registry, environment variables, shortcuts, and local directories to detect installed IDEs
Launches a user-selected local IDE or file manager to open the current workspace directory
Provides a browser UI and same-origin HTTP route for initiating local application launches
Writes IDE preferences and detection cache files in the workspace
